title: I spent 10 days building a CS2-inspired game
author: Mojito7723
selftext:
Play here: [claudestrike2.com](https://claudestrike2.com)

I’m sharing this experiment where I used Fable 5 to create an online FPS inspired by Counter-Strike 2. 

I started it out of curiosity after coming across [https://worldofclaudecraft.com/](https://worldofclaudecraft.com/) which was built in only two days. I wondered what the outcome would be for a FPS.

The results quickly exceeded my expectations, and eventually I was able to capture some of the feel of Counter-Strike 2.

Claude-Strike 2 runs directly in the browser at a high refresh rate, and is cheat-resistant by design, thanks to a server-authoritative simulation.

Some of the features:

* Ranked matchmaking with an Elo leaderboard (1v1 and 5v5).
* Lobby system (supports premades of 10 to play 5v5).
* Mechanics such as wallbangs, bhopping, strafing, spray patterns, and volumetric smokes.
* No downloaded assets: textures are procedurally generated and every sound is synthesized in the browser
* Chickens 🐔

Since it’s still experimental, there’s only one single server based in France. 

Feel free to try it and share your feedback. I’d be happy to iterate and improve the game!

A Discord server is also available: [https://discord.gg/DaGbXFJtu](https://discord.gg/DaGbXFJtu)
